#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o app .

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct{ name, in, want string }{
		{"spec example", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET b
SIZE
", "1
NULL
2
"},
		{"overwrite refreshes", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
SET a 9
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
GET c", "9
NULL
3
"},
		{"del and size", "3
SET x 1
DEL x
DEL x
SIZE
GET x
", "1
0
0
NULL
"},
		{"capacity one", "1
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
GET b
SIZE
", "NULL
2
1
"},
		{"crlf", "2
SET a 1
GET a
", "1
"},
		{"get refreshes", "2
SET a 1
SET b 2
GET a
SET c 3
GET a
GET b
", "1
1
NULL
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var sb strings.Builder
			w := bufio.NewWriter(&sb)
			if err := run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), w); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			w.Flush()
			if got := sb.String(); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestEvictionReusesEntries(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewCache(3)
	for i := range 1000 {
		c.Set(string(rune('a'+i%26))+string(rune('a'+i/26)), "v")
	}
	if c.Len() != 3 || len(c.entries) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("len=%d pool=%d, want 3 and 3", c.Len(), len(c.entries))
	}
}
